# Acquired-block Markov feedback: a separately paid planner

Exploratory extension, outside the accepted 18:24 freeze and its review.
The planner is ordinary finite-horizon coarse-MDP dynamic programming. The
question here is whether the acquired certificate actually covers its policy
class, with all additional acquisition paid. No new Bellman algorithm is claimed.

## 1. Exact task/interface

There are m unknown stochastic A_a on n explicitly named states, with the
same ordinary forward generative interface as the accepted source. The task
specifies a fixed initial probability ell and terminal reward b in [0,1]^n.
The acquired partition P=ZW must preserve both, exactly as before.

The output is an OFFLINE policy and value certificate for this explicit-state
simulator. A simulated rollout retains its current microscopic state label i;
querying (a,i) returns the next label. At each remaining horizon t the policy
looks up g=block(i) and a=pi_t(g). Actual deployment does not thereby acquire a
physical sensor, hidden-state estimator or authenticated block observation.
Those would be additional premises/costs, and are not constructed here.

The comparison class is all deterministic time-dependent Markov policies on
the acquired block labels. Randomized Markov block policies can also be
covered by convexity. Arbitrary microscopic feedback and arbitrary
history-dependent block feedback are NOT in this class. Small prediction rank
alone is not a claim that they have no advantage.

## 2. The extra operator family

Let D_g be the diagonal indicator of block g. P,Q commute with every D_g.
For a deterministic map pi:{1,...,r}->{1,...,m}, define

    A_pi = sum_g D_g A_(pi(g)),
    B_pi[g,:] = B_(pi(g))[g,:].

Both matrices are stochastic. A product of the A_pi operators represents a
time-dependent Markov block policy, with the usual backward-value ordering.
There are m^r one-step maps, not m^(rL), but m^r is still exponential in r.
The first historical construction explicitly acquired/checked ALL of them.
The current polynomial sufficient route instead uses the acquired block-norm
comparison in BLOCK_COMPARISON_PROOF.md; it does not claim an optimal norm planner.

Set D_a=sum_(g:pi(g)=a)D_g. These are disjoint orthogonal row selectors. For
any vector x,

    ||Q A_pi P x||_H²

# Candidate extension: all block-observation history policies

New investigation, NOT covered by the accepted feedback receipt/archives.
This is a uniform finite-horizon approximation theorem, not a general POMDP
solver. It must be independently checked before any accepted-scope upgrade.

## Interface and acquired inputs

The true A_a are stochastic matrices on explicitly labelled states. A learned
partition has averaging projection P=ZW, Q=I-P, and block masses pi_g=n_g/n.
A policy sees only the sequence of acquired block labels, its past actions,
and independent private randomness; it may depend on the entire history.
Initial law is block-uniform, terminal reward is block-constant in [0,1].
The same forward-simulator/map observation interface and its costs remain.
Microscopic-state policies and unobserved physical sensing are not included.

Use the SAME simultaneous operator event already received in the feedback
work: global action observation ||A_a-C_a||2<=t; incoming ||QA_aP||_H<=e_in;
outgoing max_g ||(WA_aQ)[g,:]||_(H^-1)<=e_out; stochastic coarse action B_a
with infinity row error <=d; and acquired local bounds

    U_gh >= max_a ||Q_g C_a[g,h] Q_h||2,
    H=I/n, Q_g=I_g−1_g 1_g^T/n_g.

All quantities come from the previous sampled/finite-bit acquisition, not
from the true unknown matrices. No new statistical union is required for
a deterministic implication of this already uniform event.

Define the conservative local-history constants

    c = max_g e_in/sqrt(pi_g),
    kappa = max_g [sum_h sqrt(n_h/n_g) U_gh + t/sqrt(pi_g)].

Outward rational square-root bounds suffice. Kappa need not be below one.
Let z_0=0 and z_(j+1)=min(1,c+kappa*z_j). Define

    E_hist(L)=L*d + e_out*sum_(j<L) z_j.

## Backward policy-tree induction (ordinary proof)

At a node whose observed current block is g, its action a is fixed after
conditioning on the observed history and private randomization. For each
possible next block h there is a possibly different continuation tree. Let
f_h be that tree's true expected terminal-reward function on block h. Patch
these functions into a vector f on the microscopic state space. Each entry
of f lies in [0,1]. Write f=P f+q, with block q_h=Q_h f_h.

Suppose every depth-j continuation obeys ||q_h||_(I_h/n_h)<=z_j, uniformly
over all histories and trees. Then ||q||_H<=z_j. The new current-block
residual is

    Q_g A_a f = Q_g A_a P f
